description: Julien Desmulier, Q-Leap head of testing, explains ahead of ICT Spring 2017 why software quality management and testing are essential in today's IT world.
seoTitle: Software quality management is essential in today's IT world. - Q-Leap
body:
With ICT Spring 2017 just around the corner, we asked Julien Desmulier, our head of testing, about the importance of testing, our success and the link to ICT Spring!

WHY DO YOU THINK IT’S IMPORTANT FOR Q-LEAP TO TAKE PART IN ICT SPRING?

“Looking at the attendees at ICT Spring, we noticed that Software Quality Assurance was not represented at all. Software quality management is essential in today’s IT world. A big part of Software Quality Assurance is testing, which provides valuable information about software quality and ensures that websites, applications and devices work every time, everywhere and for everyone! We want to present our services and skills at ICT Spring, so that the IT industry is aware of the importance of Software Quality Assurance. In addition to this, we want to learn from and discuss with other IT experts. We’d like to observe the latest trends and technologies, and follow the progress of companies around us. We’re also on the lookout for new customers and partners.”

HOW DO YOU PLAN TO DEMONSTRATE YOUR SERVICES AND SKILLS?

“I don’t want to spoil the surprise, but we’ll be running several on-site test demonstrations. These will be carried out on several devices and will be supported by our experts and educational materials. Our QA experts will also be on hand at our stand to meet visitors and discuss our approach to functional testing, non-functional testing, test process improvements, and test automation. We invite everyone to come and take a look at our stand and join in the conversation with us!”

If you’d like to find out more about Software Quality Assurance, receive a demonstration, or chat with Julien Desmulier and the q-leap team, you’re welcome to visit contact@q-leap.eu or come and meet us at ICT Spring 2017 on May 9 and 10! We look forward to hearing from you!

Q-LEAP AT ICT SPRING 2017!

Join q-leap at one of the world’s most influential ICT conventions, ICT Spring 2017, at the European Convention Center Luxembourg on May 9 and 10!

With over 5,000 key players in the IT world from more than 72 countries, a program of seminars and presentations by some of the industry’s leading players, and the latest market innovations, ICT Spring is the place to be for q-leap! They’ll be there with the team on a stand to share knowledge and chat with you, attend seminars and presentations to broaden our knowledge and get the latest market information.

As an influential voice in the global technology community, ICT Spring’s aim is to foster emulation and networking between decision-makers, innovation managers, start-ups, researchers and venture capitalists on a European scale. It’s an annual event held in Luxembourg City, dedicated to presenting and demonstrating the latest relevant trends and innovations, and discussing their impact on society and the world of work.
